You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json,math
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(g,ray=3,limit=4):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # markers: non-bg appearing exactly >=2 forming a diagonal
    marks=[]
    for v,n in cnt.items():
        if n>=2 and v!=bg: marks.append(v)
    mark=marks[-1] if marks else None
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==mark]
    assert len(pts)>=2
    # project along marker diagonal to sort along the line
    def proj(p): return min(a,b,p[0]-p[1])*2 # crude; better: order by r and tiebreak by c with consistent diagonal step
    pts.sort(key=lambda p:(p[0]-p[1]))  # works since they lie on one diagonal
    d=(pts[-1][0]-pts[-2][0], pts[-1][1]-pts[-2][1])
    dsgn=(abs(d[0]),abs(d[1])),d
    # canonical unit step
    import math as m
    gdc=m.gcd(abs(d[0]),abs(d[1]))
    d=(d[0]//gdc, d[1]//gdc)
    # pick sign so d aligns with marker progression
    # pts sorted by (r-c) — for diagonal lines that matches progression
    # ensure first->last follows d
    if (pts[-1][0]-pts[0][0])*d[0]<0 or (pts[-1][1]-pts[0][1])*d[1]<0:
        d=(-d[0],-d[1])
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    p=tuple(pts[-1]); cur=p
    for _ in range(limit*h*w):
        p=tuple(cur[0]+d[0], cur[1]+d[1])
        if not(0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w): break
        if g[p[0]][p[1]]==mark: continue          # skip over markers
        if g[p[0]][p[1]]!=bg:                    # hit block -> bounce
            pr,pc=p
            # try vertical-face bounce first (neighbor sideways of hit cell is bg)
            dd=(-d[0],d[1])
            nxt=(pr+dd[0], pc+dd[1])
            if 0<=nxt[0]<h and 0<=nxt[1]<w and g[nxt[0]][nxt[1]]==bg:
                d=dd
                cur=(pr,pc); continue
            dd=(d[0],-d[1])
            nxt=(pr+dd[0], pc+dd[1])
            if 0<=nxt[0]<h and 0<=nxt[1]<w and g[nxt[0]][nxt[1]]==bg:
                d=dd
                cur=(pr,pc); continue
            break   # cannot decide
        cur=p
        res[cur[0]][cur[1]]=ray
    return res

for k in ['Demo pair 1 input','Demo pair 2 input']:

import os,re,json,math
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks=[v for v,n in cnt.items() if n>=2 and v!=bg]
    mark=marks[-1]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==mark]
    # marker line direction; sort along the line by projection
    pts.sort(key=lambda p:(p[0]-p[1]))
    d=(pts[-1][0]-pts[-2][0], pts[-1][1]-pts[-2][1])
    gdc=math.gcd(abs(d[0]),abs(d[1]))
    d=(d[0]//gdc, d[1]//gdc)
    # sign: extend from the tip (last marker in line order) toward block side; tip = marker whose neighbor along d stays in-grid
    # use marker furthest in direction d
    def proj(p): return p[0]*d[0]+p[1]*d[1]
    tip=max(pts,key=proj)
    d=tuple(d)  # ensure orientation
    # normalize sign of d to be along marker progression
    if proj(tip)-proj(pts[0])<=0: d=(-d[0],-d[1])
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    # walk along d from cell after tip, collecting bg cells; record last valid cell before block/out
    src=None
    while True:
        pr,pc=src+(d) if src is not None else (tip[0]+d[0], tip[1]+d[1])
        if not(0<=pr<h and 0<=pc<w) or g[pr][pc]==mark:
            break
        if g[pr][pc]!=bg:   # blocked by block
            break
        src=(pr,pc)
        res[pr][pc]=3
        # safety stop
        if src==tip: break
    if src is None:
        return res
    p=src
    # bounce attempts: keep row-progressing; prefer keeping |dr|, flip dc
    cands=[(d[0],-d[1]),(-d[0],d[1])]
    best=None
    for cand in cands:
        rr,cc=p; path=[]
        while True:
            nr,nc=rr+cand[0], cc+cand[1]
            if not(0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w) or g[nr][nc]==mark:
                break
            if g[nr][nc]!=bg: break
            path.append((nr,nc)); rr,cc=nr,nc
        if best is None or len(path)>len(best[1]):
            best=(cand,path)
    res[tuple(src[0],src[1])]=3
    if best[1]:
        for r,c in best[1]: res[r][c]=3
    return res

for k in ['Demo pair 1 input','Demo pair 2 input']:
    o=solve(G[k]); exp=G[k.replace('input','output')]
    print(k,'MATCH' if o==exp else 'MISMATCH')
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G

    seens={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==4}

    dr,dc=pts[1][0]-pts[0][0], pts[1][1]-pts[0][1]

for n in [4,5,6]:
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    print('=== pair',n,'H,W=',H,W)
    # marker cells: nonzero non-background streaks (assume two colors: obstacle & marker)
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in I for v in row)
    # 3-cells each demo, contiguous diagonals
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c] not in (0,) and sum((r+dr,c+dc) in [(0,0)] for dr in (-1,0,1) for dc in (-1,0,1))]
    # find maximal diagonal runs of same nonzero value
    def diag_runs(grid,val):
        seen=set(); runs=[]
        for r in range(len(grid)):
            for c in range(len(grid[0])):
                if grid[r][c]==val and (r,c) not in seen:
                    st=[(r,c)];seen.add((r,c))
                    while True:
                        rr,cc=r-1,c-1
                        while 0<=rr<len(grid) and 0<=cc<len(grid[0]) and grid[rr][cc]==val:
                            st.append((rr,cc));seen.add((rr,cc))
                            rr-=1;cc-=1
                        rr,cc=r+1,c+1
                        while 0<=rr<len(grid) and 0<=cc<len(grid[0]) and grid[rr][cc]==val:
                            st.append((rr,cc));seen.add((rr,cc))
                            rr+=1;cc+=1
                        break
                    runs.append(st)
        return runs
    for val in cnt:
        if val in (0,): continue
        runs=diag_runs(I,val)
        if len(runs)==1 and len(runs[0])==3:
            seg=runs[0]
            ch=[(r,c,O[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==0 and O[r][c]!=0]
            print('seed val',val,'cells',sorted(seg),'changed',ch)

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in I for v in row)
    # marker: value appearing exactly 3 times in a diagonal
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    for val in cnt:
        if cnt[val]!=3: continue
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==val]
        cells.sort()
        dr=(cells[1][0]-cells[0][0]); dc=(cells[1][1]-cells[0][1])
        dr//=abs(dr) if dr else 1; dc//=abs(dc) if dc else 1
        # normalize: assume main diagonal
        if dr==dc:
            cells=[(min(r for r,_ in cells), min(c for _,c in cells))] # placeholder
            # find canonical form: step direction (dr,dc)
            pass
        # determine canonical (d1,d2) with d1+d2 == 0? not needed; use sorted extremal cells
        e0=min(cells); e1=max(cells)
        if (e1[0]-e0[0])*(e1[1]-e0[1])!=3: continue
        d=(e1[0]-e0[0], e1[1]-e0[1])
        d=(d[0],d[1])
        # find end cell: extend both ways and see which direction keeps inside grid
        # anchor = one step beyond end cell
        ends=[]
        for p in [e0,e1]:
            q=(p[0]+d[0], p[1]+d[1])
            if 0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W:
                ends.append((d,q,p))
        assert len(ends)==1, (H,W,len(cells),d,e0,e1)
        dd,q,p=ends[0]
        # perpendicular directions
        def ray(p0,d0):
            cells_r=[]
            r,c=p0
            while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W:
                cells_r.append((r,c))
                r+=d0[0]; c+=d0[1]
            return cells_r
        orth=[(dd[1],-dd[0]),(-dd[1],dd[0])]
        cands=[(o,ray(q,o)) for o in orth]
        # blocked if any drawn cell not background (nonzero and not marker)
        def score(cand):
            n=0; blk=False
            for r,c in cand[1]:
                if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=cnt_key_val(None): pass
                if I[r][c] not in (0,): 
                    # allow stepping onto marker cells? treat as blocked
                    blk=True; break
            return (-blk if blk else n, -n)
        best=max(cands,key=lambda c:(-any(I[r][c] and I[r][c]!=0 for r,_ in c[1]),-len(c[1])))
        for r,c in best[1]:
            out[r][c]=3
    return out

from collections import Counter

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in I for v in row)
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    for val in cnt:
        if cnt[val]!=3: continue
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==val]
        cells.sort()
        assert cells[2]-cells[1]==cells[1]-cells[0]
        d=(cells[1][0]-cells[0][0], cells[1][1]-cells[0][1])
        # first-step candidates from either end
        cand=set()
        for p in [cells[0],cells[-1]]:
            q=p+d
            if 0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W and I[q[0]][q[1]]==0:
                cand.add(q)
        if len(cand)==1:
            T=cand.pop()
            drp,dc_=(d[1],-d[0]),(-d[1],d[0])
            def walk(p,d0):
                k=[]
                r,c=p
                while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and I[r][c]==0:
                    k.append((r,c)); r+=d0[0]; c+=d0[1]
                return k
            a,b=walk(T,drp),walk(T,dc_)
            if not a and not b:
                return None
            best=max((a,b),key=len)
            for r,c in best: out[r][c]=3
    return out, cells

for n in [4,5,6]:
    pred,_=solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])
    exp=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print('pair',n,'match' if pred==exp else f'MISMATCH ({sum(pred!=o for o,r in zip(pred,exp) if True)})')

from collections import Counter

def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in I for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # wall: 2nd most common
    rest=[v for v,_ in cnt.most_common() if v!=bg]
    wall=rest[-1] if len(rest)>1 else None
    # marker: rare color(s)
    mkc={v for v in cnt if v not in (bg,wall) if cnt[v]<5}
    assert len(mkc)==1
    mc,mk=mkc,list((r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==mc)
    mk.sort()
    # anchor candidate: extend marker line both ways; valid = adjacent (diag) cell free of wall/bg-block? use any bg cell adjacent (8-conn? we used diag neighbor)
    # direction of marker line
    dr0,d_c0=mk[1][0]-mk[0][0], mk[1][1]-mk[0][1]
    cand=set()
    for e,p in [(0,mk[0]),(1,mk[-1])]:
        for sgn in (1,-1):
            q=(p[0]+sgn*dr0,p[1]+sgn*d_c0)
            if 0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W and I[q[0]][q[1]]==bg:
                cand.add(q)
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    best=None  # (path_len, path_set) lexicographic max
    for T in cand:
        for d0 in [(-d_c0,dr0),(d_c0,-dr0)]:
            def walk(p,d):
                k=[];r,c=p
                while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and I[r][c]==bg:
                    k.append((r,c)); r+=d[0]; c+=d[1]
                return k
            path=walk(T,d0)
            if not path: continue
            # reflect off wall cells: when next would be wall, flip component
            k,pathcells=k,[]; r,c=T; total=[]
            moved=False
            while True:
                for _ in range(max(len(path),1)):
                    r+=d0[0]; c+=d0[1]
                    if not (0<=r<H and 0<=c<W) or I[r][c]==bg:
                        break
                    # check wall -> reflect
                    nr,nc=r,c
                    if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and I[nr][nc]!=bg and I[nr][nc]!=mc:
                        # vertical wall (face normal horiz): flip dc
                        d0=(d0[0],-d0[1]); continue
                        # horizontal wall: flip dr
                        else:
                            d0=(-d0[0],d0[1])
                        continue
                    total.append((r,c)); moved=True
                if not total: break
            if best is None or (len(total), tuple(sorted(total)))>(best[0],best[1]):
                best=(len(tuple(sorted(total))),tuple(sorted(total)))
    if best is None: return I
    _,cells=best
    for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=3
    return out

for n in [4,5,6]:

from collections import Counter
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in I for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rest=[v for v,_ in cnt.most_common() if v!=bg]
    assert len(rest)>=2
    wall=rest[-1]; mcol=rest[-2]
    mk=sorted((r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==mcol)
    dr,dc=mk[1][0]-mk[0][0],mk[1][1]-mk[0][1]
    cand=set()
    for end in [mk[0],mk[-1]]:
        for sgn in (1,-1):
            q=(end[0]+sgn*dr,end[1]+sgn*dc)
            if 0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W and I[q[0]][q[1]]==bg:
                cand.add(q)
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    best=(-1,None)
    for T in cand:
        for d0 in [(-dc,dr),(dc,-dr)]:
            path=[]; r,c=T; d=d0
            while True:
                rr,cc=r[0]+d[0],r[1]+d[1]
                if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W) or I[rr][cc]!=bg:
                    break
                path.append((rr,cc)); r,c=rr,cc
                nr,nc=r[0]+d[0],r[1]+d[1]
                if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W) or I[nr][nc]!=bg:
                    break
                # reflect off vertical wall face (cell to the side is wall) or horizontal
                side_r,side_c = r[0]+1,r[1]+1 if False else (r[0]-1 if False else r[0]+1, r[1]-1 if False else r[1]+1)
                d=(d[0],-d[1]); continue
            n=len(path)
            if n>best[0]: best=(n,path)
    for r,c in best[1]: out[r][c]=3
    return out

def solve(I):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in I for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others={v:n for v,n in cnt.items() if v!=bg}
    mkv=min(others,key=lambda v:others[v])
    mk=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==mkv]
    dr=(mk[1][0]-mk[0][0]); dc=(mk[1][1]-mk[0][1])
    def isok(r,c): return 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and I[r][c]==bg
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    cur=mk[-1]
    while True:
        nxt=(cur[0]+dr,cur[1]+dc)
        if not (0<=nxt[0]<H and 0<=nxt[1]<W): break
        if I[nxt[0]][nxt[1]]==bg:
            cur=nxt; out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3
        else:
            # reflect across horizontal or vertical wall? try both reflections of incoming direction
            hits=False
            for q in ((-dc,-dr),(dc,-dr),(-dc,dr),(dc,dr)):
                n2=(cur[0]+q[0],cur[1]+q[1])
                if 0<=n2[0]<H and 0<=n2[1]<W and I[n2[0]][n2[1]]==bg and q!=(dr,dc):
                    cur=n2; out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3; hits=True; break
            if not hits: break
    return out

def f(g):

    # find non-background "wall" color: most common non-zero? use majority color
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v!=0)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # marker color: minority nonzero distinct
    rest={v:cnt[v] for v in cnt if v!=bg}
    mark=min(rest,key=lambda k:rest[k])
    # locate markers
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==mark]
    pts.sort()
    dr=pts[1][0]-pts[0][0]; dc=pts[1][1]-pts[0][1]
    # wall cells: color != bg and != mark (non-empty)
    def wall(r,c): return g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=mark
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    r,c=pts[-1]

                # determine which face: if moving into cell above/below within cols... simpler: try flip dc then flip dr
                if 0<=r-dr<H and wall(r-dr,c) and wall(r,c-dc):

                    r,c=r-dr,c-dc
                    continue
                if 0<=r+dr<H and wall(r-dr,c) and wall(r,c-dc):

                    r,c=r-dr,c-dc
                    continue
                if 0<=nc-dc<W and wall(r,c-dr) and wall(r-dr,c):

                    continue
                if 0<=nc+dc<W and wall(r,c-dr) and wall(r-dr,c):
                    dr=-dr; dc=-dc
                    r,c=r-dr,c-dc
                    continue
                dr=-dr; dc=-dc

import os,re,json,numpy as np
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape
    cnt={}
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            cnt[g[r][c]]=cnt.get(g[r][c],0)+1
    order=[k for k,_ in sorted(cnt.items(),key=lambda kv:-kv[1])]
    bg,wall,mk=order[0],order[1],order[2]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==mk]
    d=(pts[-1][0]-pts[0][0], pts[-1][1]-pts[0][1])
